title: Workspace removal dialog
brief: The destructive-confirm dialog for removing a workspace, under the gate ruling: 0 chats removes freely; N >= 1 chats offers the single destructive path 'Delete N chats (M MB) and remove'. Anatomy per the maintainer: title is the question, one consequence line with the scope in bold, NO inner card, no boxed path, destructive button last/red/scope-labelled, actions right-aligned, path elided monospaced. Each artboard shows both states. Copy born bilingual in the app; artboards show the English column.

artboards.title: A: the question asks, the path speaks
artboards.tradeoff: Fastest to confirm; weakest justification for the destructive case — nothing between question and buttons

artboards.title: B: evidence before the red button
artboards.tradeoff: The loss is backed by an expandable list of the chats with their sizes — more deliberate, one interaction deeper

artboards.title: C: one quiet line
artboards.tradeoff: Most compact, tuned for the frequent harmless case; the destructive case leans on the button's own words
